name: EasyGrade v1.0.1
notes:
## EasyGrade v1.0.1

### Bug Fixes
- Position DMG support icons over a nobrowse mount so no .fseventsd lands in the image
- Park DMG support file icons off-screen so they never show in the installer window
- Hide DMG support files so Finder on macOS 26 shows only the app and Applications

### Maintenance
- Correct Linux artifact names in README and release notes


---

### Downloads

| Platform | Download |
|----------|----------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `EasyGrade-1.0.1-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `EasyGrade-1.0.1-x64.dmg` |
| Windows (Installer) | `EasyGrade-Setup-1.0.1.exe` |
| Windows (Portable) | `EasyGrade-Portable-1.0.1.exe` |
| Linux (AppImage) | `EasyGrade-1.0.1-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux (Debian) | `EasyGrade-1.0.1-amd64.deb` |

### Installation

**macOS**: Download the DMG, open it, and drag EasyGrade to your Applications folder.

**Windows**: Download and run the installer, or run the portable EXE directly. If you see a SmartScreen warning, click "More info" then "Run anyway".

**Linux (AppImage)**: Download the AppImage, make it executable (`chmod +x`), and run with: `./EasyGrade-*.AppImage --no-sandbox`

**Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)**: Install the .deb package: `sudo dpkg -i EasyGrade-*.deb`
